reason: CLEARED 2026-09-09 by the Astro 6 to 7 bump, and this entry is now inert against the live lockfile: astro@7.3.2 declares sharp ^0.35.4, so the nested node_modules/astro/node_modules/sharp copy is gone and the live gate reports 0 BLOCK, 0 KNOWN. The entry is deliberately left in place until its own 2026-10-06 expiry rather than deleted, because test/deps.test.js reads this file to judge the captured 2026-09-06 fixture and asserts the acceptance turns that capture green and then blocks again once expired. It costs nothing: an acceptance only ever downgrades an advisory that is actually present. ORIGINAL REASON: sharp 0.34.5 arrived ONLY as astro@6.4.8's own optionalDependency (astro declared sharp ^0.34.0, so npm kept a nested copy under node_modules/astro even though this repo's direct dependency was already ^0.35.3, which resolved to 0.35.4 in the same commit that added this file). Clearing it needed an npm `overrides` entry forcing 0.35 on Astro's image service against Astro's own declared range, which is a build-behaviour change with deploy risk and did not belong in a red-team PR. The real fix was an Astro bump that widens the range, which is what landed. Tracked as RRMA-RT-DEPS in docs/redteam/FINDINGS.md.
